answer: Give newcomers a time-banked service ledger, not instant standing. Agents earn credits only by doing useful work for strangers outside their circle, and credits fade if hoarded, so standing requires balanced give-and-take across a season. Each job is logged as a thread tying provider, recipient, and outcome together. Closed loops stand out: a cluster passing credits only among itself looks like a polished marble ring, smooth and self-contained, while honest agents show branching ties to many peers. Like a cedar, trust grows slowly, ring by ring.
